lab_metadata.institution: National University of Computer and Emerging Sciences

questions.problem_statement: Analyze the results of 5 students, each having marks in 3 subjects (Programming Fundamentals, Mathematics, and English), using nested loops and nested if-else statements. Requirements: 1. Outer loop for 5 students. 2. Inner loop to input marks for 3 subjects. 3. Validate marks between 0 and 100, re-prompting with an error message on invalid input. 4. Assign grades per subject (80-100: A, 70-79: B, 60-69: C, 50-59: D, <50: F). 5. Use nested if-else to check if all subjects are at least 50 to pass. 6. Display each student's marks, grades, total out of 300, percentage, and Pass/Fail status.

Calculate bills for 4 cafeteria customers, each purchasing 3 items, using nested loops. Requirements: 1. Outer loop for 4 customers. 2. Inner loop for 3 item prices. 3. Reject zero or negative prices and re-prompt. 4. Use nested if-else after computing subtotal: if subtotal >= Rs. 5,000, apply 15% discount with membership card or 10% without; if subtotal < Rs. 5,000, apply 5% discount with membership card or 0% without. 5. Display subtotal, discount amount, and final bill for each customer. 6. Display total revenue collected after discounts across all customers.

Input a positive integer N and print a centered star pyramid using nested loops. Requirements: Use an outer loop for rows and inner loops for leading spaces and stars. The first row has 1 star, each subsequent row increases by 2 stars, the pyramid is centered, and the last row contains 2N - 1 stars.

Input an integer N (>= 3) and print an N x N square pattern using nested loops. Requirements: Outer loop for rows, inner loop for columns, print '*' on the border or either diagonal and a space elsewhere, output N characters per row with a newline after each row, and display an error message if N < 3.

Monitor daily household electricity consumption in units for up to 30 days using a while loop. Requirements: If a reading is negative, print 'Invalid Reading' and skip it using continue; if > 500 units, print 'Unusually High Consumption'; if 0 is entered, stop reading using break; process at most 30 readings; display the count of valid readings and total consumption at the end.
Declare an integer array 'int numbers[5]', initialize it with five integer values at declaration time, and display all elements in a single line using a loop.

Identify duplicate roll numbers among N students using a 1D integer array and nested loops. Requirements: 1. Input N (1 <= N <= 100). 2. Store N roll numbers in a 1D array. 3. Use nested loops to find duplicates. 4. Print each duplicated roll number only once even if it appears more than twice. 5. Display a message if no duplicates exist.
sample_outputs:
Input:
Enter number of students: 7
Enter roll numbers: 101 102 103 102 104 101 105

Output:
Duplicate roll numbers:
101
102

questions.problem_statement: Count how many times each distinct quiz mark appears for N students using a 1D array and nested loops. Requirements: 1. Input N (1 <= N <= 100). 2. Store student marks (0 to 100) in a 1D integer array. 3. Use nested loops to compute frequencies of distinct marks. 4. Display each distinct mark and its frequency once. 5. Display the highest frequency and all marks tied for it.
